justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/LoadedTypeInitializer.java` (lines 186-248) and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/LoadedTypeInitializerCompoundTest.java` (lines 18-65). `Compound` is a very small composite wrapper with one field, 2 constructors, and only 2 behaviors (`onLoad`, `isAlive`); it just flattens nested `Compound`s, skips `NoOp`s, and delegates to contained initializers.
